entries.note: Interpret only the visible terminal cells supplied by re_terminal_file_at. Markdown label/target spans and plain file-looking tokens are supported; never execute a reference or infer an OSC-8 target from a label alone. The terminal provides UTF-8 byte offsets for clicked cells and includes nearby wrapped rows and stored history. Displayed parenthesized paths and Markdown targets can contain application-inserted newlines before the terminal edge. Remove only row-break padding/indentation inside those delimited spans; ordinary hard breaks between unrelated plain references remain delimiters. Clicking either displayed fragment resolves the same full target.

entries.note: Percent-decode once, reject control bytes and nonlocal URI authorities, separate a positive source location, match absolute paths to the originating terminal root on a segment boundary, then normalize relative dot segments without escaping that root. The service still enforces canonical-path/symlink and regular-file boundaries. Root switching and tab movement must never substitute the active project. Existing editor buffers are focused without reloading or writing them.

Cmd/Ctrl-click is a local open-file gesture; consume both mouse press and release so an agent with negotiated mouse tracking never receives half a click. Ordinary input retains the terminal protocol. Hover is refreshed separately after rendering, without requiring a modifier; click remains modifier-gated. The opening session and its process remain alive.

Use the same originating-root validator for the hover affordance and opening. Recompute against the latest rendered terminal rectangles/cells, so layout changes and new output release obsolete hover. Menus, drags and inactive windows suppress the cursor. Select the actual SDL hand cursor only for a valid local reference; restore the default otherwise. No file reads, decoding or per-frame allocation occur on hover. main.c owns the cursor resource and input enter/leave/focus state.
